voice.speaker: Project Plateau narrator
voice.name: Energetic Male
voice.profile: young, energetic, clear American English promotional voice

text: [bright, youthful, and curious] What if a novel became more than dialogue and lore? [brisk and confident] We turned Arthur Conan Doyle's The Lost World into Project Plateau: a playable first-person expedition. Cross a connected plateau. Track footprints through the brush. Study a living dinosaur family. Commit four glass plates while danger circles overhead. Every shot changes what you can prove. Every return asks what evidence survived. NovelToGame connects source analysis, concept, world design, art direction, build, and evidence-based QA in one open workflow. [energetic] Play Project Plateau. Explore the process. Star the repository.
